race.comment: PEACEFUL RULER (2) showed good promise last campaign and wasn't beaten far in the Raconteur before never featuring in the Belmont Guineas. He's right back in grade today though and those formlines have been very strong. Trial coming in was solid and he can return with a bang. MY AUTHORITAH (4) had some trouble last start but still flashed home last start to finish off nicely. Out to 1400m now is a bonus and while he's likely to get back again, this is an easier assignment. Watch for him flying late in the race. QUOKKA ROCKA (8) disappointed fresh but was strong behind an in-form galloper last start at the midweeks. Out to 1400m now is a big tick and CJP's booking adds confidence. Well placed to make his presence felt. DIAMOND DANCER (3) just missed two back before a 1L defeat through the same race as QUOKKA ROCKA. I'M ODETTE (5) won well on resumption and can keep the ball rolling.
